import { describe, it, test } from "node:test";
import assert from "node:assert/strict";
import { createPost } from "../src/posts.js";

describe("empty", () => {
  it("creates a post", async () => {
    await createPost({ title: "x" });
  });

  it("creates a post with its title", async () => {
    const post = await createPost({ title: "x" });
    assert.equal(post.title, "x");
  });
});
